title: Where Is...?
description: Ask for directions to a place
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Вы местный? Мне нужна помощь.
systemPrompt: You are a local giving directions. Use: прямо (straight), налево (left), направо (right). Keep replies short (1-2 sentences).
completionCriteria: User asked for directions and acknowledged your help.
hints: Как пройти к...? (How do I get to...?)
Спасибо за помощь! (Thanks for the help!)
objectives: Ask where a place is (Где магазин?)
